author: Atheyna
body:
Recently, the Map Development has had a re-assessment of Avicus maps in the Nebula DTM and TDM categories. Maps in all other gamemodes were not touched.

The following maps were removed during the re-assessment for Nebula DTM.
- Butterfly
- Campi Erbosi
- Candyland I
- CherrylandMC
- Clay Wars
- Cleyra
- Curabitur
- Formorgar II
- Infernus II
- Justice II
- Lesenct
- Luar
- Proelium
- Revixit II
- Sandstorm
- Teres

The following maps were removed during the re-assessment for Nebula TDM.
- Boundaries
-  Gladiator
- Wooly Caverns

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Gladiator was removed due to it's poor aesthetics factor, making it not very pleasant. There seemed to be lots of spawn-killing and spawn camping going on in the map. It just resulted in too many issues at the moment. The map was moved to the storage folder until it's re-vamped and re-added. 
The map wasn't removed permanently.
